טבלה: מידע לקבלת תביעה
This table outlines the information Harel provides to claimants upon receiving a claim application. It details the documents and notices a claimant should expect to receive, and the timelines for providing updates.
ממדים: Stages in claim process / Documents provided, Information type / Action required

D.  DoFuPHnWs DnG inIorPDWion Ior FlDrifFDWion oI D FlDiP
Upon Harel or whomsoever on its behalf, receiving an application related to fling a claim, the applicant shall receive the following documents as soon as possible:
A copy of this set of rules;
A document detailing the claim clarifcation and settlement process;
Guidelines regarding how the plaintiff is required to act, including information regarding the plaintiff's right to receive indemnifcation for expenses incurred by him/her and for which Harel is obliged to provide indemnifcation (e.g. indemnifcation for steps taken by him/her to mitigate the damage, indemnifcation for payments to experts for opinions, etc.)
Details of the information and documents required of the plaintiff in order to clarify and settle the claim;
A claim fling form, if any - and instructions for completing it;
A notice regarding the claim prescription period.
■ You may browse the aforementioned documents on the website.
Harel shall provide the plaintiff as soon as possible with a written notice detailing the documents received by it together with the date of receipt, as well as the information and documents required which have not yet been furnished by the plaintiff.
In the event that Harel requires additional information and documents from the plaintiff in order to clarify the claim, these documents will be demanded within fourteen (14) business days after it becomes apparent that same are needed.
■ The provisions of this paragraph shall not apply to a claim proceeding in court.
